verdict.rationale: Requesty documents per-key and per-service-account monthly spend caps and service accounts, but nothing in the evidence shows these, or key creation, can be provisioned programmatically through an admin or management API. They appear to be configured through the platform, and the OpenAPI probe found no published API spec at the paths tried. The axis applies to an LLM gateway, so this absence of evidence is "none", not "na".
